Datetime parsing for the %f directive now supports various numbers of digits after the comma, ensuring consistent behavior regardless of fractional second precision.

The classes FixedTzOffset, RepeatedNameError, and the functions date_convert and extract_format are now correctly exported and behave according to the specifications.

The Parser class now exposes a formatter property that allows access to the formatting logic associated with the parsed result.

The Parser class and extract_format function now allow hyphen-minus characters within field names during pattern matching and extraction.

The Parser class and extract_format function now support grouping characters (commas and underscores) in decimal format strings for proper number parsing.

No network access is required to complete the tasks in this problem. The code can run entirely within a sandboxed copy of the repository.

The probability that each requirement is met is 1.
